description: Convert a date/time from one IANA time zone to one or more others with correct daylight-saving rules. Returns local times, UTC offsets, abbreviations and the UTC instant.

from_tz.description: IANA zone of the input wall time (default UTC; ignored if time has an offset)

to_tz.description: Target IANA zone(s), comma-separated, e.g. America/New_York,Asia/Tokyo

name: timezone_convert
title: Convert a time between time zones (DST-aware)
